name: App API frida-server (on-demand, enabled apps only)
purpose: for apps the user enabled that pin TLS or sign requests, an in-app hook reads the request the way the app itself does (so we reuse the app's own auth/headers and never re-implement auth). frida-server is pushed but KEPT STOPPED; it runs only during an explicit capture window for a single enabled app, then stops.
installedBy: targets/android/rooted/rooted.sh app-frida install [BIN] (runs targets/android/rooted/app-frida.sh: stage the hook-server binary 0700 root-only, default STOPPED; start/stop bound to one enabled package) — INSTALLED ON-DEVICE by the on-device agent with the user present; not from the Mac
selinux: unchanged — runs as a root process under Magisk; does NOT set permissive or alter policy
scope: attaches ONLY to a package the user enabled, only during an active capture; detaches and the server stops afterwards. No other app is touched.
lifecycle: default STOPPED; started per-capture; stopped on capture end and on idle
status: NOT YET INSTALLED — the install target (app-frida.sh via rooted.sh app-frida install) now exists; start refuses any package the owner has not enabled in the App API (allowlist); on-device install + a one-time uninstall test are the on-device agent's step, user present

commands: rooted.sh app-frida remove   (stops it + deletes the staged binary)
remove.note: stop the process + delete the binary; nothing persists. Keep nothing.
